# Preparing data with modified Lab variables


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(car)
#library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(DataExplorer)
library(tableone)
library(Publish)
library(jtools)
require(mice)
require(autoCovariateSelection)
require(data.table)
# BiocManager::install("GenomicRanges")
require(GenomicRanges)
```


# Load data

```{r, cache=TRUE}
load(file = "data/fullcovproxy.RData")
ls()
```

# List variables

```{r, cache=TRUE}
demovars <- c("age.cat",  # Age
  "sex",  # Sex
  "education",  # Education
  "race", # Race/ethnicity 
  "marital",  # Marital status
  "income",  # Family yearly income
  "born",  # Where born / citizenship 
  "diabetes.family.history",    # Family history of diabetes
  "high.cholesterol",  # High cholesterol
  "smoking",    # Smoking status
  "diet.healthy",  # How healthy is the diet 
  "physical.activity",  # Vigorous physical activity 
  "medical.access",    # Access to routine healthcare
  "sleep") # sleep
# demographic variables in a formula
demoform <- paste0(demovars, collapse = "+")
demoform
```

# Modifications

```{r, cache=TRUE}
# exposure
fullcovproxy.data$exposure <- relevel(as.factor(fullcovproxy.data$obese), ref = "No")
fullcovproxy.data$exposure <- ifelse(fullcovproxy.data$exposure == "No", 0 ,1)
# outcome
fullcovproxy.data$outcome <- relevel(as.factor(fullcovproxy.data$diabetes), ref = "No")
fullcovproxy.data$outcome <- ifelse(fullcovproxy.data$outcome == "No", 0 ,1)
# original lab variables
labvars.original <- c("uric.acid", 
                      "protein.total", 
                      "bilirubin.total", 
                      "phosphorus",
                      "sodium", 
                      "potassium", 
                      "globulin", 
                      "calcium.total", 
                      #"high.cholesterol",
                      "systolicBP", 
                      "diastolicBP")
labvars.original
labvars.originalform <- paste0(labvars.original, collapse = "+")
# modified lab variables
fullcovproxy.data$l1 <- with(fullcovproxy.data, (log(globulin)))
fullcovproxy.data$l2 <- with(fullcovproxy.data, (protein.total*calcium.total))
fullcovproxy.data$l3 <- with(fullcovproxy.data, (diastolicBP/systolicBP)^2)
fullcovproxy.data$l4 <- with(fullcovproxy.data, sqrt(uric.acid+bilirubin.total)/2)
fullcovproxy.data$l5 <- with(fullcovproxy.data, (phosphorus^1.75/(sodium*potassium)))
fullcovproxy.data$l6 <- with(fullcovproxy.data, log(systolicBP+10))
# Summarize modified lab variables
summary(fullcovproxy.data$l1)
summary(fullcovproxy.data$l2)
summary(fullcovproxy.data$l3)
summary(fullcovproxy.data$l4)
summary(fullcovproxy.data$l5)
summary(fullcovproxy.data$l6)
# modified lab variables in a formula
labvars <- paste0("l",1:6)
labform <- paste0(labvars, collapse = "+")
labform
```


```{r, cache=TRUE}
# select empirical covariates that have RR of < 0.8 
# or > 1.2 compared with the outcome
y <- as.logical(as.vector(fullcovproxy.data$outcome))
df.emp <- fullcovproxy.data[c("id", proxy.list)]
rcd <- get_relative_risk(df = df.emp, outcomeVec = y)
var.list.emp <- data.frame(var = proxy.list, rr = rcd)
dim(var.list.emp)
var.list.emp2 <- var.list.emp[order(abs(var.list.emp$rr), decreasing = TRUE), ]
var.list.emp3 <- subset(var.list.emp2, rr < 0.8 | rr > 1.2)
dim(var.list.emp3)
sel.proxy <- var.list.emp3$var
sel.proxy.form <- paste0(sel.proxy, collapse = "+")
length(sel.proxy)
length(proxy.list[proxy.list %in% sel.proxy])
length(sel.proxy[sel.proxy %in% proxy.list])
sel.proxy.form
```


# Save

```{r save, eval=TRUE, cache=TRUE}
full.data <- fullcovproxy.data
save(demovars, demoform, labvars, labform, 
     labvars.original, labvars.originalform,
     sel.proxy, sel.proxy.form, 
     full.data, fullcovproxy.data, proxy.list,
     file = "data/MasterPlasmodeData.RData") 
```
